To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
FTY720 does not protect mice from traumatic brain injury despite reducing posttrauma inflammation.

FTY720, an immune modulator, is ineffective to reduce lesion size and functional deficits in a mouse model of focal cortical cryolesion or weight-drop contusion injury, despite a significant reduction of circulating lymphocytes, a reduced infiltration of immune cells into brain tissue and a preserved blood-brain barrier.
FTY720, despite its immunosuppressive effect, does not reduce brain damage or improve neurological outcome after focal or diffuse TBI.

the development and evaluation of new therapeutic approaches for the treatment of traumatic brain injury.
